show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Mason Morfit and Rob Hale – Quiet Activism at ValueAct (EP.462)
summary:
Since its founding in 2000, ValueAct has charted a
distinctive path in activist investing, eschewing confrontation and
publicity in favor of quiet, meaningful partnerships with
management teams. But they agreed to join me to reflect as they celebrate the firm’s
25th anniversary this year. Mason helped launch the firm and has
driven many of its successful investments, including the turnaround
of Microsoft in 2013.
